Starbucks to open first India Global Capability Center in Chennai

Starbucks has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Tamil Nadu government to establish its first Global Capability Center (GCC) in India, located in Chennai. The company aims to create approximately 800 jobs through this initiative. The GCC will focus on global technology operations.
